notes.title: [0.0.5] Content Update, UI Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Frequent updates to add or fix features will happen throughout the early access! To get more insights on our development progress, join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/zugf3gtdCj]Discord Server[/url]!

[list]
[*] New Chest Model for Reward Boxes
[*] Cards collected can now be viewed via TAB button
[*] Buff Bar UI to show passives and buffs
[*] Updated Ability swapping capabilities
[*] Fixed an issue with continuous ability casting where it will stop working after some time
[*] Added Mini boss rooms with 1 Miniboss (Mini Treant)
[*] Added Treant Boss
[/list]

notes.title: [0.0.4] Minor Updates, Multiplayer & UI Fixes
notes.notes:
Frequent updates to add or fix features will happen throughout the early access! To get more insights on our development progress, join our [url=https://discord.gg/zugf3gtdCj]Discord Server[/url]!

[list]
[*] Fixed Chat Profile Picture being incorrect
[*] Fixed Loot Notification sometimes not being shown
[*] Fixed some holes in the Forest Dungeon
[*] Fixed Steam sessions not being destroyed when stopping or leaving a multiplayer session
[*] Updated Training Grounds to spawn different types of mobs
[*] Updated Gunslinger default weapon on spawn to Handgun
[*] Moved NPCs to their correct locations
[*] Alt Mouse Mode can now be closed by pressing Alt again
[*] Loadout UI now tracks weapon pickups
[/list]
